step.cmd: To start the entire cullet system:

ul.li: At the Belt Conveyor Control screen, display the Silofeeding Cullet screen.
Turn on the entire system by pressing the Start button.

note.p: If only the belt conveyor must be started, such as for maintenance, skip this step and go to Step 2 below.

ul.li: Make sure that the belt conveyor and safety mechanisms are in fault-free condition and functioning correctly.
Switch on the belt conveyor using the lockable main switch at the control cabinet.
Acknowledge the emergency stop using the user interface at the control cabinet.
Place in Manual mode to start the belt.

step.cmd: To turn off the belt conveyor:

ul.li: Shut down the belt conveyor using the user interface at the control cabinet.
The belt conveyor continues to run and terminates the movements of the actuators/
Switch off the belt conveyor using the lockable main switch.
The belt conveyor is now switched off.

step.cmd: LO/TO the belt conveyor using the lockable main switch at the disconnect.
